verdict.rationale: Every MCP item in the evidence describes Zapier acting as an MCP server that exposes its app actions to outside AI clients such as Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor. Nothing shows Zapier, including its Agents product, connecting to third-party MCP servers to use their tools. Server-side MCP and tool bundles are a different role and earn no credit here, and the axis is still a fair question for an automation platform with agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
